title: Grade 4 Science — Mon, Jun 01
description: Animals & Their Habitats — Day 1 of 5: What is a habitat?
subject: science

questions.question: The natural place where an animal lives is called its:
questions.explanation: A habitat is the natural home where an animal finds food, water and shelter.

questions.question: Which of these is a land habitat?
questions.explanation: A forest is a habitat on land, while oceans, ponds and rivers are water habitats.

questions.question: A fish lives in a:
questions.explanation: Fish live in water habitats such as rivers, ponds and oceans.

questions.question: Three things every animal needs from its habitat are food, shelter and:
questions.explanation: Animals need food, water and shelter to survive in their habitat.

questions.question: The hot, dry, sandy habitat where camels live is called a:
questions.explanation: A desert is a hot and dry habitat with very little water.

questions.question: Which animal lives in a polar (very cold) habitat?
questions.explanation: Polar bears live in the very cold, snowy polar regions.

questions.question: A habitat with lots of trees and many animals is a:
questions.explanation: Forests have many trees and are home to a large variety of animals.

questions.question: Why can a fish not live on dry land for long?
options: It needs water to breathe and move
It does not like the sun
questions.explanation: Fish breathe oxygen from water using gills and need water to survive.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a need an animal gets from its habitat?
questions.explanation: Animals get food, water and shelter from their habitat; a school bag is a human-made object.

questions.question: A grassland habitat is mostly covered with:
questions.explanation: Grasslands are open areas covered mainly with grass and a few small plants.

questions.question: Animals that live in water are also called:
questions.explanation: Animals that live in water are called aquatic animals.

questions.question: Which is an example of a water habitat?
questions.explanation: A pond is a water habitat where fish, frogs and water plants live.

questions.question: A frog can live both in water and on land. It is called a/an:
questions.explanation: Animals that live both in water and on land, like frogs, are called amphibians.

questions.question: Different animals live in different habitats because:
options: Each animal is suited to a certain place
questions.explanation: Each animal has a body and habits suited to its particular habitat.

questions.question: Which habitat would you expect to find a cactus and a camel?
questions.explanation: Both cactus plants and camels are suited to the hot, dry desert habitat.
